ETS‑Lindgren to Showcase Innovative Solutions at September Tabletop Shows: San Diego Test Equipment Symposium, Minnesota EMC Event, EMI Summit & Open House, and Milwaukee IEEE EMC Seminar
 September 10, 2026
CEDAR PARK, Texas, September 10, 2026 – ETS‑Lindgren, the global leader in Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Radio Frequency (RF) Measurement Solutions, is pleased to announce its participation in four prominent industry tabletop events this September: the San Diego Test Equipment Symposium 2026 (SDTES), the 2026 Minnesota EMC Event, the EMI Summit & Open House in Massachusetts, and the 2026 Milwaukee IEEE EMC Seminar.
The event series begins on Tuesday, September 15, at SDTES, held from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm (PDT) at Advanced Test Equipment Rentals (ATEC). ETS‑Lindgren’s booth will be staffed by Ron Ahlquist, ETS‑Lindgren’s representative with Altamont Technical Services. Visitors to the booth will learn about the company’s Test and Measurement Solutions and have the opportunity to review the popular Top 10 Brochures, which provide practical, application-oriented considerations to ensure successful project outcomes. Click here to explore topics ranging from Anechoic Absorber to Satellite Test Chambers.
The Minnesota EMC Event will take place on Tuesday, September 22, from 8:00 am to 4:00 pm (CDT) at the DoubleTree by Hilton Minneapolis Airport in Bloomington. This all-day seminar brings together regional EMC professionals for a series of technical presentations, practical insights, and case studies, including topics related to EMC requirements, test procedures, and industry standards. ETS‑Lindgren’s Test and Measurement Full Line Brochure will also be available at this event for attendees interested in exploring the full suite of EMC and RF Solutions.
On Wednesday, September 23, ETS‑Lindgren will participate in the EMI Summit & Open House, hosted at Element Materials Technology in Boxborough, Massachusetts, from 8:00 am to 4:00 pm (EDT). The Summit includes a full day of expert-led sessions addressing current challenges and emerging trends in EMI testing and compliance along with live demonstrations and guided laboratory tours. Attendees can stop by ETS‑Lindgren’s table to pick up the Test and Measurement Full Line Brochure and speak with technical representatives.
The final gathering at the 2026 Milwaukee IEEE EMC Seminar will take place on Thursday, September 24, from 7:30 am to 5:00 pm (CDT) at the Royle Hotel (formerly Four Points by Sheraton) near the Milwaukee Airport in Wisconsin. This full-day seminar will feature technical presentations, exhibitor displays, and live demonstrations, all centered on practical EMC design and troubleshooting techniques for product engineers. ETS‑Lindgren will have its Test and Measurement Full Line Brochure available at the event, along with a new datasheet highlighting the 3170 Intell-I-Tune™ Antenna Solution, the company’s latest innovation designed to deliver automated tuning and improved measurement efficiency for EMC testing applications.
“These events provide a valuable opportunity to engage with engineers and industry leaders, exchange technical insights, and showcase ETS‑Lindgren’s innovative solutions for EMC and RF testing,” said Janet O’Neil, Customer Relations Manager at ETS‑Lindgren. “We’re proud to support the EMC community and look forward to connecting with attendees across these key regional forums.”
ETS‑Lindgren invites all attendees to stop by its tabletop displays at each event to explore a wide range of Testing Solutions, including Chambers, Antennas, Instrumentation, and Turnkey Systems designed to meet today’s EMC and RF compliance requirements.
Contact us to discuss your testing goals with our team and see how ETS‑Lindgren remains Committed to a Smarter, More Connected Future.
About ETS‑Lindgren
ETS‑Lindgren is an international manufacturer of components and systems that measure, shield, and control electromagnetic energy. The company’s products are used for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), microwave, wireless, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) testing, electromagnetic field (EMF) measurement, radio frequency (RF) and personal safety monitoring.
Headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas, ETS‑Lindgren has manufacturing facilities in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of ESCO Technologies, a leading supplier of engineered products for growing industrial and commercial markets. ESCO is a New York Stock Exchange listed company (symbol ESE) with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Additional information about ETS‑Lindgren is available at www.ets-lindgren.com. Follow ETS‑Lindgren on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube. Additional information about ESCO and its subsidiaries is available at www.escotechnologies.com.

 SCIF 
ETS‑Lindgren designs and builds SCIFs that meet U.S. and international RF shielding and TEMPEST requirements. Integrated shielding, filtering, and monitoring protect classified communications from electronic compromise.
At ETS‑Lindgren, we provide advanced security solutions specifically tailored for SCIF (Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility) applications. Our SCIF shielding solutions are designed to ensure the utmost confidentiality of communications and data by preventing external electromagnetic signals from penetrating the facility. We understand the importance of protecting classified information, and our custom shielding systems are engineered to create a secure environment where sensitive data remains safe from surveillance or tampering.
Our SCIF solutions include comprehensive shielding for walls, doors, windows, and any potential points of entry, ensuring that all aspects of the facility are fortified against electronic threats. We utilize cutting-edge materials and design techniques to provide reliable, continuous protection against both passive and active threats, including signals from external sources. In addition to our shielding systems, we also offer monitoring and integration solutions to guarantee that your SCIF meets all security standards and regulations, offering peace of mind that your facility is fully protected.
To ensure the success of your SCIF project, we offer consulting and design services that are critical to developing a solution that meets your specific needs. Our team works closely with you throughout the entire project, from initial planning and assessment to system design and final installation. We consider every aspect of the project to ensure optimal shielding performance and regulatory compliance, helping you avoid any pitfalls that could affect your security objectives. By leveraging our extensive expertise in electromagnetic shielding and our collaborative approach, ETS‑Lindgren delivers tailored solutions that meet the unique security requirements of SCIFs, ensuring that sensitive operations can proceed securely, without the risk of unwanted surveillance or electronic breaches. With our SCIF shielding solutions, you can trust that your classified information remains fully protected, allowing you to focus on your operations with confidence.

 HEMP, EMP, and IEMI 
National security infrastructure must withstand extreme electromagnetic events. ETS‑Lindgren delivers hardened facilities and validation systems to protect defense electronics from HEMP, EMP, and IEMI threats.
At ETS‑Lindgren, we provide comprehensive security solutions specifically designed to protect against HEMP (High-Altitude Electromagnetic Pulse), EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse), and IEMI (Intentional Electromagnetic Interference) threats. Our shielding systems are engineered to safeguard critical infrastructure from these potentially disruptive and damaging electromagnetic events. We understand the importance of ensuring the integrity and security of your assets in the face of these high-intensity electromagnetic risks, and our solutions are crafted to prevent these events from causing harm or operational disruption.
Our HEMP, EMP, and IEMI shielding solutions include advanced materials and designs that offer effective protection for a wide range of applications. Whether it’s protecting mission-critical facilities, communication systems, or sensitive equipment, our shielding technologies are built to absorb or redirect electromagnetic energy, ensuring that your systems remain operational and secure even during extreme events. We provide both facility-wide shielding solutions, such as specialized filters and large enclosures, and more localized protections like small rackmount enclosures that can be implemented within existing systems to protect individual devices.
In addition to our robust shielding technologies, we offer a range of consulting and design services to ensure that your HEMP, EMP, and IEMI protection is tailored to meet your specific requirements. Our team works closely with clients to assess vulnerabilities, design effective shielding solutions, and implement them to ensure maximum security. Whether you’re protecting a data center, communication infrastructure, or other critical assets, our solutions help mitigate the risks posed by electromagnetic threats, giving you confidence that your systems will remain protected, secure, and fully operational, no matter the electromagnetic challenges you may face.

 Secure Conference Rooms (Government , Military, Commercial) 
Sensitive government and corporate discussions require electronically secure spaces. RF shielding and filtered penetrations from ETS‑Lindgren prevent signal leakage and eavesdropping.
At ETS‑Lindgren, we offer advanced security solutions designed to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of communications in secure conference rooms for both government and commercial applications. We understand that protecting sensitive discussions and data is essential in these environments, and our shielding systems are tailored to create a secure space that guards against unauthorized surveillance and electronic interference. From initial design to construction and commissioning, we guide our clients through every stage to ensure the final product exceeds security expectations.
Our comprehensive solutions include the installation of state-of-the-art shielding materials for walls, doors, and windows to prevent eavesdropping or data leaks. We also offer specialized monitoring systems to ensure that the secure conference room continues to meet high-level security protocols, providing peace of mind to our clients. Whether it’s a high-level government briefing or a commercial negotiation, we ensure that all aspects of the conference room remain shielded from potential external threats. Throughout the entire process, from design to commissioning, we work closely with clients to meet specific security standards and deliver a fully functional, secure environment.
With our years of experience in providing security solutions, ETS‑Lindgren brings unparalleled expertise to designing, constructing, and commissioning secure conference rooms that adhere to stringent security requirements. Our solutions provide confidence and protection, ensuring that sensitive information discussed within these spaces remains private and secure. By taking a comprehensive approach, we ensure the seamless integration of design, construction, and final commissioning to deliver a secure, reliable space for our clients.

 TEMPEST 
ETS‑Lindgren provides TEMPEST-rated enclosures and shielding systems that block compromising emanations. These solutions prevent classified information from being captured through unintended electronic emissions.
ETS‑Lindgren is a global leader in electromagnetic security, providing advanced TEMPEST shielding and testing solutions that protect sensitive and classified information from electromagnetic compromise. TEMPEST encompasses the standards and practices designed to prevent the unintentional emission of electromagnetic signals—known as compromising emanations—that could expose sensitive or classified information. These emissions, often generated by electronic or digital equipment, can be intercepted and analyzed to reconstruct data, posing serious risks to information security. To safeguard data integrity and national security, TEMPEST compliance ensures that equipment, systems, and facilities effectively control these emissions through advanced shielding and rigorous testing.
Building on decades of experience in RF shielding, EMC test systems, and secure facility design, ETS‑Lindgren delivers fully integrated TEMPEST solutions tailored to government, defense, and high-security commercial applications. Our comprehensive capabilities include the design and manufacture of RF shielded enclosures, anechoic chambers, shielded doors, windows, and penetrations engineered for maximum attenuation and long-term reliability. We also provide complete secure facility integration, including SCIF and SAPF designs that meet the most demanding specifications, along with engineering, design, and compliance services that support TEMPEST validation, accreditation, and maintenance.
With thousands of installations worldwide, ETS‑Lindgren delivers the expertise, precision, and proven performance required to protect the world’s most sensitive environments—ensuring electromagnetic integrity and uncompromising information security.
